passages.text: Our class makes welcome boxes for pupils returning after a long absence. I tie a blue string around one box so the lid stays in place. Inside are a card, a pencil and notes from different classmates. When Ben returns after being ill, he still feels weak and cannot carry many books. We put the box on his desk and ask which jobs he wants help with. He chooses a book-carrying partner but reads the messages by himself. The welcome is quiet, and Ben decides when to join the louder games.

parallelText.zh: 我们班为长期缺课后返校的同学制作欢迎盒。

parallelText.en: I tie a blue string around one box so the lid stays in place.
parallelText.zh: 我用蓝绳把一个盒子拴好，让盖子固定住。

parallelText.en: Inside are a card, a pencil and notes from different classmates.
parallelText.zh: 里面装着卡片、铅笔和不同同学写的留言。

parallelText.en: When Ben returns after being ill, he still feels weak and cannot carry many books.
parallelText.zh: 本生病后返校时，仍感到虚弱，搬不动很多书。

parallelText.en: We put the box on his desk and ask which jobs he wants help with.
parallelText.zh: 我们把盒子放到他的课桌上，问他哪些事需要帮忙。

parallelText.en: He chooses a book-carrying partner but reads the messages by himself.
parallelText.zh: 他选择一位帮忙搬书的同伴，但自己阅读留言。

parallelText.en: The welcome is quiet, and Ben decides when to join the louder games.
parallelText.zh: 欢迎活动很安静，本自己决定什么时候加入更热闹的游戏。

wordHelp.meaning: a period of being away
the top that closes a container
coming back

passages.text: The walking club meets at school beside a map of two routes to the river. One route is a kilometre long; the other is shorter but crosses a busy car park. Our teacher chooses the longer route because it follows a quiet path. Before we leave the school gate, everyone checks their water and meeting time. Along the path, we mark a small bridge and a noticeboard on our maps. At the river, each pair compares its map with another pair. We agree that a useful route description tells more than just the distance.

parallelText.en: The walking club meets at school beside a map of two routes to the river.
parallelText.zh: 步行社团在学校集合，旁边有两条通往河边的路线图。

parallelText.en: One route is a kilometre long; the other is shorter but crosses a busy car park.
parallelText.zh: 一条路线长一公里，另一条较短，但要穿过繁忙的停车场。

parallelText.en: Our teacher chooses the longer route because it follows a quiet path.
parallelText.zh: 老师选择较长的路线，因为它沿着安静的小路走。

parallelText.en: Before we leave the school gate, everyone checks their water and meeting time.
parallelText.zh: 离开校门前，大家检查饮用水并核对集合时间。

parallelText.en: Along the path, we mark a small bridge and a noticeboard on our maps.
parallelText.zh: 沿途，我们在地图上标出小桥和告示板。

parallelText.en: At the river, each pair compares its map with another pair.
parallelText.zh: 到河边后，每对同学把地图与另一对的对照。

parallelText.en: We agree that a useful route description tells more than just the distance.
parallelText.zh: 我们认为，有用的路线说明不应只有距离。

wordHelp.meaning: a way from one place to another
a board where public messages are displayed
words explaining what something is like
